item.title: Voices within Democratic Party to Retain Supplemental Investigations: Hong Ki-won to Propose Criminal Procedure Act Amendment on 14th (민주당서 ‘보완수사 존치’ 목소리…홍기원, 14일 형소법 발의)
item.description:
Amid the Democratic Party’s Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Task Force (TF) proposing on the 9th a revision to abolish prosecutors’ supplementary investigation powers, voices within the party are emerging that such powers should be exceptionally retained for crimes against socially vulnerable groups. The Democratic Party is set to discuss the direction for handling the Criminal Procedure Act amendment at a general meeting of lawmakers on the 14th, where heated debate is expected. (더불어민주당 형사소송법 개정 티에프(TF)가 지난 9일 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안을 발의한 가운데, 사회적 약자 대상 범죄의 경우 예외적으로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 목소리가 당내에서 나오고 있다. 민주당은 14일 의원총회에서 형사소송법 개정안 처리 방향을 논의하기로 했는데 격론이 예상된다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Hong Ki-won announced on the 13th that he would propose a Criminal Procedure Act amendment centered on allowing prosecutors to exceptionally conduct direct supplementary investigations for crimes against socially vulnerable groups and crimes infringing on public livelihood. In a letter sent to all party lawmakers requesting co-sponsorship, Hong stated, “If even a single victim suffers unfairly as a result of completely banning supplementary investigations, can we call that a successful reform?” (홍기원 민주당 의원은 13일 사회적 약자 범죄, 민생 침해 범죄 등에 한해 예외적으로 검찰의 직접 보완수사를 허용하는 내용을 뼈대로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 발의하겠다고 밝혔다. 홍 의원은 이날 “보완수사를 전면 금지한 결과 단 한 명이라도 억울한 피해자가 발생한다면, 그것을 성공한 개혁이라고 말할 수 있겠느냐”며 당 의원 전원에게 법안 공동발의를 요청하는 친전을 보냈다.)

The Criminal Procedure Act amendment Hong plans to propose as early as the 14th is based on allowing supplementary investigations only in unavoidable cases, including: △crimes against socially vulnerable groups (specified serious crimes, sexual violence, child and adolescent sex crimes, stalking, child abuse, abuse of persons with disabilities, elder abuse, domestic violence); △crimes infringing on public livelihood (voice phishing, financial investment fraud, multi-level marketing); and △time-sensitive cases (detention cases, cases nearing statute of limitations). However, for prosecutors to conduct direct supplementary investigations, the case must be recognized as identical, and if coercive measures are needed during the supplementary investigation, approval from the head of the local prosecution office is required. (홍 의원이 이르면 14일 발의할 예정인 형사소송법 개정안은 △사회적 약자 범죄(특정강력범죄·성폭력·아동청소년성범죄·스토킹·아동학대·장애인학대·노인학대·가정폭력) △민생 침해 범죄(보이스피싱·금융투자 사기·다단계 판매 등) △시한이 촉박한 사건(구속사건·공소시효 임박사건) 등 불가피한 경우에 한해 보완수사를 예외적으로 허용하는 것을 뼈대로 한다. 다만, 검찰이 직접 보완수사를 하기 위해서는 사건의 동일성이 인정돼야 하고, 보완수사 중 강제수사가 필요한 경우 지방공소청장의 승인을 받도록 했다.)

Beyond Hong, lawmakers Kim Nam-hee and Kim Dong-ah also held a press conference on this day with women’s groups, announcing they would prepare legislation to protect victims’ rights during investigations. Lawmaker Ko Min-jung, running for party leader in the August 17 party convention, also stated on MBC radio, “Even if limited to crimes against socially vulnerable groups, particularly sexual violence cases, it is necessary to retain supplementary investigation powers.” (홍 의원 외에도 김남희·김동아 의원도 이날 여성단체와 함께 기자회견을 열고 수사 과정에서 피해자의 권리를 보호하기 위한 법안을 마련하겠다고 밝혔다. 8·17 전당대회 당대표에 출마한 고민정 의원도 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오에서 “사회적 약자 특히 성폭력 사건 이런 것에 국한해서라도 보완수사권은 놔두는 게 필요하다”고 했다.)

However, as a majority within the party argues for abolishing supplementary investigation powers, heated debate is expected at the general meeting of lawmakers on the 14th, where the Criminal Procedure Act amendment will be discussed. A first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, “There will be fierce debate at the general meeting, but it seems unlikely that a consensus will be reached.” (다만 당내 다수는 보완수사권 폐지를 주장하고 있어, 형사소송법 개정안을 논의하기로 한 14일 의원총회에서 격론이 예상된다. 한 수도권 초선 의원은 “의원총회에서 격론이 벌어지겠지만 의견이 모이기는 쉽지 않을 것 같다”라고 말했다.)

The People Power Party has decided to propose a Criminal Procedure Act amendment as party policy this week, which would maintain prosecutors’ supplementary investigation powers. Lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek told reporters after the general meeting, “We have decided to discuss supplementary measures including a so-called ‘full-case referral system’ where all cases concluded solely by the police are sent to the prosecution,” adding, “For serious crimes like the Gwangju female high school student murder case, the amendment will also include a provision allowing prosecutors and judicial police officers to consult from the early stages of the investigation.” (국민의힘은 검찰의 보완수사권을 유지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 이번 주 중 당론으로 발의하기로 했다. 곽규택 의원은 의원총회 직후 기자들과 만나 “경찰이 단독으로 종결한 사건은 모두 검찰에 송치하는 이른바 ‘전건송치제’를 포함한 보완 방안을 논의하기로 했다”며 “광주 여고생 살해 사건과 같은 중대범죄의 경우 사건 초기부터 검찰과 사법경찰관이 협의해 수사를 진행할 수 있도록 하는 조항도 개정안에 포함하기로 했다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Household Electricity Should Be Cheap When There's Surplus, Expensive During Peak Times" (이 대통령 “가정용 전력도 남아돌 땐 싸게, 피크타임엔 비싸게 바꿔야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 13th, "When there is surplus electricity, it should be cheap; when it's insufficient during peak times, it should be expensive. We need to change the electricity pricing system." (이재명 대통령이 13일 “전력이 남아도는 시간에는 싸게 피크타임으로 부족할 때는 비싸게, 전기요금 체계를 바꿔야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee made this remark at the National Fiscal Strategy Meeting held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, in response to an expert argument that the market price is distorted because electricity rates are the same regardless of consumption time. After hearing from Climate and Environment Energy Minister Kim Seong-hwan that a time-differentiated pricing system has already been introduced for industrial electricity rates, President Lee said, "It should be expanded to household use later." He also noted that time-differentiated pricing would help improve the efficiency of heat pumps, which are gaining attention as a high-efficiency, low-carbon eco-friendly heating system utilizing renewable energy. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 국가재정전략회의에서 전력 소비 시간대와 무관하게 요금이 동일해 시장 가격이 왜곡되고 있다는 취지의 전문가 주장에 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 산업용 전기요금의 경우 이미 시간대별 차등 요금제가 도입됐다는 김성환 기후환경에너지부 장관의 설명을 듣고는 “가정용도 나중에 확대해야 된다”고 했다. 또 시간대별 차등 요금제가 재생에너지를 활용한 고효율·저탄소 친환경 난방시스템으로 주목받는 히트펌프의 효율성 증대에도 도움이 될 것이라고 했다.)

However, President Lee drew a line on immediate reforms, stating, "Realistically, it's hard to talk about (household electricity rate reform) now due to price management." He added a caveat, "If there are no issues with price burdens or citizens' income, household electricity rates should be adjusted." Furthermore, he said, "If we were to increase household electricity rates across the board, we would have no choice but to introduce a system to support low-income groups through vouchers." (다만 이 대통령은 “냉정하게 지금은 물가관리 때문에 (가정용 전기요금 개편을) 얘기하긴 어렵긴 하다”며 당장의 개편 가능성에 대해선 선을 그었다. 이어 “물가 부담이나 국민들의 소득에 문제가 없다면 가정용 전기요금을 조정해야 되는 상황”이라고 거듭 단서를 달았다. 아울러 “가정용 전기요금을 전면적으로 올린다고 하면 저소득층에 대해서는 바우처 형태로 지원하는 제도를 도입하는 수밖에 없다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: “If We Can’t Replace the Party Leader, the Party Will Be Shaken”… Song Young-gil: “Jeong Cheong-rae’s Leadership Must Be Wound Up” (김민석 “대표 교체 못 하면 당 흔들려”…송영길 “정청래 체제 정리해야”)
item.description:
As the race for party leadership officially kicks off with former Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae’s declaration to run in the August 17 national convention, key rival candidates—former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil—have launched a coordinated barrage of attacks against Jeong. (정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표의 8·17 전당대회 출마 선언으로 본격적인 당권 경쟁이 시작되자, 유력 경쟁 후보인 김민석 전 국무총리와 송영길 의원이 나란히 정 전 대표를 향해 파상 공세를 폈다.)

At a party members’ meeting in Anyang, Gyeonggi Province on the 13th, former Prime Minister Kim directly targeted Jeong, who is seeking re-election, stating, “If we fail to replace the party leader this time, our party will be shaken.” Kim added, “The president will be shaken, too. Our government will be shaken. The entire Republic of Korea will be shaken together.” He argued, “Now is the time for us to create a Democratic Party that wins again.” Targeting Jeong, he pledged, “From the day after the national convention, I will begin upgrading the candidate nomination system to ensure that we never again see unfair nominations where the leadership talks about fairness but undermines its own consistency.” He also emphasized that if he becomes leader, he would “start a ‘politics of addition’ that embraces rational progressives, reformers, centrists, and conservatives alike.” <<> Lawmaker Song also raised the issue of Jeong’s accountability. In an interview with the YouTube channel ‘Spic’ on the same day, he said, “If the Jeong (Cheong-rae) leadership system is not wound up as soon as possible, we’ll end up in a situation like the second ‘Hong Myung-bo system,’ where even advancing to the World Cup finals would be difficult.” He claimed, “Jeong’s narrow, self-centered leadership essentially caused the defeat in the local elections.” <<> Song continued his fierce attacks, saying, “Is there any constitutional history where the ruling party leader and the president, with four years left in the president’s term, are locked in a ‘Myung-Cheong Battle’? The sight of a ruling party in such a state is so absurd it makes me want to cry.” He added, “Do you think we can win the general election with Jeong Cheong-rae’s face? Even our own sons and daughters wouldn’t vote for him.” <<> Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr (김 전 총리는 13일 경기 안양시에서 연 당원간담회에서 “이번에 당대표를 교체하지 못하면 우리 당은 흔들린다”며 연임에 도전하는 정 전 대표를 직격했다. 김 전 총리는 “대통령도 흔들릴 것이다. 우리 정부가 흔들릴 것이다. 대한민국이 함께 흔들릴 것이다”라며 “이제 우리가 다시 이기는 민주당을 만들어야 할 때”라고 했다. 그는 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “다시는 말로는 공정하다고 얘기하고 그 일관성을 지도부가 스스로 깨는 잘못된 공천이 일어나지 않도록 확고한 시스템 공천의 업그레이드를 전당대회 다음날부터 시작하겠다”고 했다. 자신이 대표가 되면 “합리적 진보·개혁·중도·보수를 모두 다 끌어안는 ‘덧셈 정치’를 시작하겠다”고 강조하기도 했다.)

item.title: Korea-U.S.-Japan SMR cooperation: "A strategic alliance to check China and Russia's nuclear renaissance" (한·미·일 ‘SMR 협력’에…“중·러 ‘원전 굴기’ 견제 전략적 동맹”)
item.description:
The decision by South Korea, the United States, and Japan to cooperate on Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) is being interpreted as the emergence of a strategic technology alliance aimed at checking the 'nuclear renaissance' of China and Russia. (한국·미국·일본이 소형모듈원자로(SMR) 협력에 나서기로 한 것은 중국과 러시아의 ‘원전 굴기’를 견제하려는 전략적 기술동맹의 등장이라는 해석이 나온다.)

Regarding the recent signing of a Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) on the deployment of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) by the foreign ministers of South Korea, the U.S., and Japan, a foreign ministry official stated on the 13th, "The purpose of this MOC is to establish a government-level cooperation framework so that the nuclear power industries of Korea, the U.S., and Japan can jointly enter the global SMR market, starting with the Indo-Pacific region." (최근 한·미·일 외교장관이 소형모듈원자로(SMR) 보급을 위한 협력각서(MOC)에 서명한 것에 대해 외교부 당국자는 13일 “이번 협력 각서의 목적은 한미일 원전 업계가 인태 지역을 시작으로 글로벌 SMR 시장에 공동 진출할 수 있도록 정부 차원의 협력 틀을 마련하는 것”이라고 말했다.)

On the 7th, the foreign ministers of South Korea, the U.S., and Japan signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) on the deployment of Small Modular Reactors in the Indo-Pacific region in Ankara, Turkey, during the NATO summit. This is known to have been led by the U.S. to counter Russia and China, which are expanding their share in the global nuclear power market with price competitiveness and other advantages. The three countries initially agreed to focus on exporting SMRs to the Indo-Pacific region, where countries like Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, and Singapore have announced plans to introduce SMRs. Indonesia, in particular, is already cooperating with the U.S. and Japan. (지난 7일 한·미·일 외교장관은 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의가 열린 튀르키예 앙카라에서 인도·태평양 지역에서 소형모듈원자로 보급을 위한 협력각서(MOC)에 서명했다. 이는 가격 경쟁력 등을 앞세워 세계 원전 시장에서 지분을 확대하고 있는 러시아와 중국에 대응하기 위해 미국이 주도한 것으로 알려졌다. 3국은 초반에는 인도·태평양 지역에 소형모듈원자로를 수출하는 데 집중하기로 했는데 이 지역에서는 인도네시아, 태국, 베트남, 싱가포르 등이 소형모듈원자로 도입 계획을 발표했으며 인도네시아의 경우 이미 미국, 일본과 협력 중이다.)

**Interpreted as a move toward 'camp formation of nuclear supply chains'** (‘원전 공급망의 진영화’ 움직임으로 해석)

The U.S. has unrivaled technology in the SMR field but halted nuclear power plant construction after the 1979 Three Mile Island accident. Japan's nuclear supply chain shrank following the Fukushima nuclear disaster during the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake. South Korea, having continuously accumulated nuclear construction capabilities since building Kori Unit 1 in the late 1970s, is renowned for adhering to deadlines and budgets, but lags behind the U.S. in SMR technology. Ultimately, the plan is to combine U.S. design technology, Japan's supply chain, and South Korea's construction capabilities to create synergies and establish standards for SMR technology. (미국은 소형모듈원자로 분야에서 독보적 기술을 가지고 있지만, 1979년 스리마일 원전 사고 이후 원전 시공을 중단했고, 일본은 2011년 동일본 대지진 당시 후쿠시마 원전 사고로 원전 공급망이 축소된 상황이다. 한국은 1970년대 후반 고리 1호기 건설 이후 원전 시공 역량을 지속적으로 축적해 납기와 예산을 지키는 데 정평이 나 있지만, 소형모듈원자로 기술력은 미국과 격차가 있다. 결국 미국의 설계 기술, 일본의 공급망, 한국의 시공 능력을 합해 시너지를 내고, 소형모듈원자로 기술의 표준을 만들어간다는 구상이다.)

In particular, the Korea-U.S.-Japan cooperation in the SMR field, which is expected to account for over 30% of global nuclear power demand by 2050, goes beyond commercial and economic considerations. It is interpreted as a 'camp formation of nuclear supply chains' reflecting strategic considerations to block the rapid expansion of China and Russia in the global nuclear power sector, which influences countries' energy policies. (특히 2050년께 전 세계 원전 수요의 30% 이상을 차지할 것으로 예상되는 소형모듈원자로 분야의 한미일의 협력은 상업적·경제적 고려를 넘어, 국가들의 에너지 정책을 좌우하는 전세계 원전 분야에서 중국, 러시아의 급속한 확장을 차단하려는 전략적 고려가 반영된 ‘원전 공급망의 진영화’ 움직임으로 해석된다.)

Currently, the Russian company Rosatom dominates the global large-scale nuclear plant construction market, leading reactor and nuclear fuel supply—from construction and fuel supply to spent fuel processing and decommissioning. China is also assessed to have the potential for rapid overseas expansion, leveraging a nuclear supply chain that is over 90% domestic. Notably, China is known to be planning to install the world's first commercial SMR within this year. Nuclear power projects take over 100 years from construction start to decommissioning, and with many countries now embarking on nuclear plant construction, the likelihood of a China-Russia-centric nuclear ecosystem expanding has increased. Against this backdrop, the signing of the Korea-U.S.-Japan SMR cooperation MOC is widely seen as being led by the U.S. (현재 러시아 기업 로사톰은 원전 건설부터 원료 공급, 사용후 핵연료 처리와 폐로까지 원자로와 핵연료 공급을 주도하면서 세계 대형 원전 건설 시장의 강자 위치를 차지하고 있다. 중국도 90% 이상을 국내화한 원전 공급망을 앞세워 앞으로 급속하게 해외로 진출할 잠재력을 갖췄다는 평가를 받는다. 특히 중국은 올해 안에 세계 최초로 상업용 소형모듈원자로를 설치할 예정으로 알려져 있다. 원전은 건설 시작부터 폐로까지 100년 이상이 걸리는 사업이고 현재 많은 국가들이 원전 건설에 나서면서 중·러 중심의 원전 생태계가 확장될 가능성이 높아졌다. 이런 배경을 고려하면 이번 한미일 소형모듈원자로 협력 각서 체결은 미국이 주도한 것으로 보인다는 관측이 유력하다.)

A foreign ministry official explained that the three governments of Korea, U.S., and Japan "began consultations in the first half of last year, reached agreement on the text in the first half of this year, and signed it on the occasion of the trilateral foreign ministers' meeting during the NATO summit." The official stated, "The Indo-Pacific region is expected to see the largest increase in new nuclear power demand going forward," adding, "If the capabilities of Korea, the U.S., and Japan are combined, we expect to offer competitive alternatives to countries in the region. Indeed, since the MOC signing, we have received positive feedback through various diplomatic channels." (외교부 당국자는 한미일 3국 정부가 “지난해 상반기부터 협의를 개시해 올해 상반기에 문안 내용에 합의했고, 북대서양조약기구 정상회의 때 열린 3국 외교장관 회의를 계기로 서명하게 된 것”이라고 설명했다. 이 당국자는 “인태 지역은 앞으로 신규 원전 수요가 가장 많이 증가할 것으로 예상되는 지역”이라며 “한미일의 역량이 결합한다면 역내 국가들에 경쟁력 있는 대안을 제공할 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 실제 MOC 체결 후 여러 외교 채널을 통해 이를 환영하는 반응도 확인되고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

**Could the Korea-U.S. enrichment and reprocessing talks gain positive momentum?** (한미 농축·재처리 협상 긍정적 동력될까)

From South Korea's perspective, participation in this Korea-U.S.-Japan SMR cooperation—alongside securing next-generation nuclear technology and joining standardization efforts—could also generate positive momentum for the ongoing Korea-U.S. enrichment and reprocessing negotiations. Although the Korea-U.S.-Japan SMR cooperation is not directly related to the Korea-U.S. enrichment and reprocessing talks, there are observations that if South Korea builds trust through SMR cooperation with the U.S. and demonstrates its ability to contribute to strengthening the U.S. nuclear supply chain, it could help secure authority over uranium enrichment. (한국의 입장에서 보면, 이번 한미일 소형모듈원자로 협력 참여가 차세대 원전기술을 확보하고 표준화에 동참한다는 것과 함께, 진행중인 한미 농축·재처리 협상에도 긍정적인 동력이 될 가능성을 기대할 수 있다. 한미일 소형모듈원자로 협력이 한미 농축·재처리 협상과 직접 관련된 것은 아니지만, 한국이 미국과 소형모듈원자로 협력을 통해 신뢰를 쌓고, 미국의 원전 공급망 강화에 기여할 역량을 입증하면 우라늄 농축 권한 확보에도 도움 될 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.)

A foreign ministry official remarked, "The U.S. also recognizes the importance of having a reliable ally in the Asian region in terms of energy security," adding, "While the U.S. previously viewed South Korea only from a non-proliferation perspective, it is now significant that the U.S. sees South Korea as a mutually beneficial nuclear partner and requested SMR cooperation." (외교부 당국자는 “미국도 에너지 안보 측면에서 신뢰할 만한 동맹을 아시아 지역에 갖는 게 중요하다는 인식을 가지고 있다”면서 “이전에는 비확산 측면에서만 한국을 봤다면, 이제는 미국이 한국을 상호 이익이 되는 원자력 분야 파트너로 보고 SMR 협력을 요청했다는 것은 의미가 있다”고 말했다.)

Kim Ji-hoon, Deputy Head of the Korea-U.S. Nuclear Cooperation Task Force (TF), who is in charge of the Korea-U.S. enrichment and reprocessing negotiations, also emphasized in a LinkedIn post on the 9th that strengthening the Korea-U.S. nuclear fuel partnership would help introduce SMRs on a large scale—currently just a goal—and bolster the energy security of both nations. Deputy Head Kim noted that commercializing SMRs, which are still in development, requires a stable supply of High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU), and stated, "If (Korea and the U.S.) successfully agree through consultations to secure South Korea's civilian uranium enrichment capabilities, it will help achieve the goal of securing a stable and reliable supply of enriched uranium for the peaceful use of nuclear energy." (한미 농축·재처리 협상을 담당하고 있는 김지훈 한미 원자력협력 티에프(TF) 부대표도 지난 9일 링크드인에 올린 글에서 한미가 핵연료 파트너십을 강화하면 현재는 목표에 불과한 소형모듈원자로를 대규모로 도입하는 데 도움이 되고 한미 양국의 에너지 안보도 강화될 것이라고 강조했다. 김 부대표는 아직 개발 단계인 소형모듈원자로을 상업화하려면 고순도저농축우라늄(HALEU)의 안정적인 공급이 필요하다면서 “(한미가) 성공적인 협의를 통해 한국의 민수용 우라늄 농축 역량 확보에 합의한다면 원자력의 평화적 이용을 위해 안정적이고 믿을 수 있는 농축 우라늄 공급을 확보한다는 목적 달성에 도움될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: “Won’t Use Party Leadership to Run for President… Will Be a Planner for Presidential Victory” (정청래 “대표직 이용해 대선 출마 안 해…대선 승리 기획자 될 것”)
item.description:
Former Democratic Party of Korea leader Jung Cheong-rae officially declared his bid for re-election as party leader on the 13th, stating, “I will not use the party leadership to run for president.” With Jung’s declaration, the lineup for the August 17 party convention is now complete, and a fierce contest is anticipated. (정청래 더불어민주당 전 대표가 13일 당대표직 연임 도전을 공식 선언하며 “대표직을 이용해 대선에 출마하지 않겠다”고 말했다. 정 전 대표의 출마 선언으로 8·17 민주당 전당대회 대진표가 완성된 가운데 치열한 접전이 예고된다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly’s Communication Hall that afternoon, Jung said, “I am running for party leader trusting only public sentiment and party sentiment,” adding, “I will strongly push for uninterrupted reform—swift and decisive reform. I will become an even stronger reform-minded party leader once again.” This declaration comes just 19 days after he resigned as leader amid calls for him to take responsibility for the June 3 local elections and not to run in the convention. (정 전 대표는 이날 오후 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 “오직 민심, 오직 당심만 믿고 더불어민주당 대표에 출마한다”며 “중단 없는 개혁, 전광석화 속전속결의 개혁을 강력하게 추진하겠다. 다시 한번 더 강력한 개혁 당대표가 되겠다”고 말했다. 6·3 지방선거 책임론과 전당대회 불출마 요구 속에 대표직을 사퇴한 지 19일 만의 출마 선언이다.)

In his declaration, Jung repeatedly emphasized “the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration,” highlighting himself as “Jung Cheong-rae, who has practiced putting the party before himself, the one who will remain loyal to President Lee Jae-myung to the end.” He said, “Looking at the path I have walked shows the path ahead. Since joining the Democratic Party, I have never left it once,” calling himself a “single-minded Democratic Party fool.” This appears to be an attempt to refute criticism from some within the party about “self-serving politics,” while also highlighting the 2002 departure from the party of strong rival Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister. (정 전 대표는 출마 선언에서 “이재명 정부 성공”을 여러 차례 강조하며 “이재명 대통령에게 끝까지 의리를 지킬 사람은 선당후사를 실천해온 저 정청래”라고 부각했다. 그는 “지나온 길을 보면 나아갈 길이 보인다. 민주당에 입당한 이래 한번도 민주당을 떠나본 적이 없다”며 “일편단심 민주당 바보”라고 했다. 당 일각에서 제기돼온 ‘자기 정치’ 비판을 반박하는 동시에, 강력한 경쟁자인 김민석 전 국무총리의 2002년 탈당 이력을 부각하려는 의도로 보인다.)

Jung went on to say, “I will not use the party leadership to run for president,” adding, “I will become a planner for presidential victory. I will run the party with fairness and integrity.” This makes clear his intention not to use the party leader position as a “stepping stone” for a presidential bid. When asked if this meant he wouldn’t run even if given the chance, Jung simply replied, “Please understand it as I stated.” (정 전 대표는 이어 “당대표직을 이용해 대선에 출마하지 않겠다”며 “대선 승리의 기획자가 되겠다. 당을 공명정대하게 운영하겠다”고 말했다. 대권을 바라보는 ‘징검다리’로서 당대표 자리를 차지하지 않겠다는 뜻을 분명히 한 것이다. 정 전 대표는 ‘대선 출마 기회가 와도 하지 않겠다는 뜻인가’란 질문을 받고 “말씀드린 대로 이해해주시면 된다”고만 했다.)

Emphasizing “reform tasks,” he said, “I will completely, 100 percent finish the abolition of supplementary investigative powers. Prosecution reform is the flag and symbol of Democratic Party reform.” On the controversial proposal during his tenure to merge with the Innovation Party, he stated, “If I become party leader, I will put the issue of the merger to a vote of all party members,” adding, “I will achieve a total unity of capable progressive forces.” After the press conference, Jung told reporters regarding the unresolved issue of introducing a preferential voting system for the party leadership election three days before candidate registration begins (on the 16th), “If the issues with the party constitution and rules are resolved, I will abide by any decision made.” (그는 ‘개혁 과제’를 강조하면서는 “보완수사권 전면 폐지는 완벽하게, 100% 마무리하겠다. 검찰개혁은 민주당 개혁의 깃발이자 상징”이라고 했고, 임기 중 제안했다 논란이 됐던 조국혁신당과의 합당에 대해서는 “당대표가 되면 합당에 대한 의견을 전 당원 투표로 묻겠다”며 “유능한 진보세력의 총단결을 이뤄내겠다”고 했다. 정 전 대표는 회견 뒤 기자들과 만나 후보 등록 시작(16일) 사흘 전까지 결론 나지 않은 당대표 선거 선호투표제 도입에 대해 “당헌·당규 (위반) 문제가 해소되면 어떤 결정을 하든 따르겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The Democratic Party’s leadership election will now be a five-way race, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, lawmaker Song Young-gil, lawmaker Ko Min-jung, and former Gangjin County Council Chair Kim Bo-mi, who have already declared their candidacies. Appearing on the YouTube channel ‘Saenal’ that afternoon, Jung explained why he declared his candidacy later than others, saying, “I planned to do it on the 10th, the day Lee Jae-myung declared his re-election bid two years ago, but I thought it would be discourteous since the president was on a foreign trip. I felt Monday would be better than Sunday [the day after the president’s return], so I did it today.” (민주당 당대표 선거는 앞서 출마를 선언한 김 전 총리, 송영길 의원, 고민정 의원, 김보미 전 강진군의회 의장 등 5파전으로 치러지게 됐다. 정 전 대표는 이날 오후 유튜브 ‘새날’에 출연해 다른 후보들보다 출마 선언이 늦었던 이유에 대해 “(2년 전) 이재명 당대표 연임 출마 선언날인 10일에 맞춰서 하려고 했는데, 대통령이 외국 순방 중이어서 실례가 되겠다 (생각했다)”며 “(대통령 귀국 다음날인) 일요일보다 월요일이 좋겠다 해서 오늘 했다”고 설명했다.)

Declarations from individuals close to Jung for the Supreme Council elections have also followed. Lawmaker Choi Min-hee announced on Facebook the previous day, “I will become a Supreme Council member who steadfastly defends the leadership.” Following that, lawmaker Han Min-soo, who served as Jung’s chief of staff, posted on Facebook that day, “The success of the Lee Jae-myung administration is my paramount task,” hinting at a declaration for candidacy on the 14th. (정 전 대표와 가까운 인사들의 최고위원 선거 출마 선언도 잇따랐다. 최민희 의원이 전날 페이스북을 통해 “지도부를 굳건하게 지키는 최고위원이 되겠다”고 밝힌 데 이어, 정 전 대표의 비서실장이던 한민수 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “이재명 정부 성공은 저에게 지상 과제”라며 14일 출마 선언을 예고했다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democracy’s ‘Revival of Elected Youth Supreme Council Members’… Divergent Intentions Among Party Leadership Candidates (민주 ‘선출직 청년 최고위원 부활’…당권 주자들 엇갈린 속셈)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea is experiencing turmoil over the introduction of elected youth supreme council members at its August 17th national convention. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회 선출직 청년최고위원제 도입을 두고 진통을 겪고 있다.)

On the 9th, the party’s national convention preparation committee decided to revive the youth supreme council member system after eight years, designating one of five elected supreme council members as a youth representative. This move came amid growing concerns over declining support among the 2030 generation following the June 3rd local elections, leading to a reorganization of the system to expand youth participation. The Democratic Party had originally introduced the youth supreme council member system in 2015 as part of party reform but abolished it in 2018. (당 전당대회준비위원회(전준위)는 지난 9일 8년 만에 청년최고위원제를 부활시키기로 하고 선출직 최고위원 5명 가운데 1명을 청년최고위원으로 하기로 했다. 6·3 지방선거를 기점으로 2030세대 지지율 하락에 대한 위기감이 커지면서 청년 참여 확대 차원에서 제도를 재정비한 것이다. 민주당은 2015년 당 혁신 차원에서 청년최고위원제도를 도입했지만 2018년 이를 폐지했다.)

However, with differing stances among key party leadership candidates, the preparation committee’s decision has failed to clear the supreme council hurdle. Chung Cheong-rae, a former party leader who declared his candidacy for party chair on the 13th, stated, “To implement a youth supreme council member system, we need to establish new party rules and regulations,” adding, “Under the current circumstances (with little time left until the convention), is it feasible to introduce elected youth supreme council members?” He proposed not holding a direct election for youth supreme council members at this convention, but instead appointing them as ex-officio members through a separate party member vote after the convention. (그러나 유력 당권 주자들의 입장이 엇갈리며 전준위 결정은 최고위원회 관문을 넘지 못하고 있다. 13일 전당대회 당대표 출마를 선언한 정청래 전 대표는 “청년최고위원제를 하려면 당헌·당규를 신설해야 한다”며 “지금 (전당대회까지 시간이 얼마 남지 않은 시점에서) 여러가지 여건상 (선출직 청년최고위원 도입이) 가능하겠냐”고 말했다. 이번 전대에서 ‘직선’ 청년최고위원을 뽑지 말고 전대 뒤 별도 당원투표를 통해 뽑은 청년최고위원을 지명직에 임명하자는 것이다.)

Some within the party speculate that Chung may be uneasy about Jeong Min-cheol (25), deputy chair of the policy committee, and Kim Hyung-nam (37), former secretary-general of the Military Human Rights Center, both of whom have declared their intention to run for youth supreme council member. The two have shown a critical stance toward Chung. In contrast, Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister, has expressed a willingness to follow the preparation committee’s decision. (당내 일부에서는 정 전 대표가 청년최고위원 도전을 선언한 정민철(25) 정책위원회 부의장과 김형남(37) 전 군인권센터 사무국장을 껄끄러워하는 것 아니냐는 시각도 있다. 두 사람은 정 전 대표에게 비판적인 태도를 보였다. 반면, 김민석 전 국무총리 쪽은 전준위 결정에 따르겠다는 태도다.)

Candidates vying for youth supreme council member positions argue that the system should be implemented as decided by the preparation committee. Kim Hyung-nam, the former secretary-general, said, “There is a difference in representativeness between being elected through a national convention and being appointed.” Deputy Chair Jeong Min-cheol also emphasized, “Being elected holds significant meaning for young politicians.” (청년최고위원에 나선 후보들은 전준위 결정대로 선출직 청년최고위원제를 도입해야 한다는 의견이다. 김형남 전 사무국장은 “전당대회를 통해 선출되는 것과 지명되는 것은 대표성에서 차이가 있다”고 말했다. 정민철 부의장도 “청년 정치인들에게 선출되는 것은 중요한 의미”라고 말했다.)

Lawmaker Jeon Eun-soo posted on Facebook, “President Lee Jae-myung, during a video conference a month ago during his European tour, ordered speeding up the establishment of a dedicated youth policy organization,” and added, “How can the Democratic Party claim to have reform and a future if it can’t even include one youth member in the supreme council?” (전은수 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “이재명 대통령은 한달 전 유럽 순방 중 화상회의에서 ‘청년정책 전담 기구 설립’을 서두르라고 지시했다”며 “최고위에 청년 한명 들이지 못하는 민주당에 어떻게 혁신이 있고 미래가 있겠느냐”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee says report on ‘rifle soldiers have never seen’ is “political attack based on fabrication” (이 대통령 ‘병사들 본 적 없는 총’ 보도에 “조작 기초한 정치 공격”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung responded on the 13th to a report alleging that the majority of active-duty soldiers had ‘never even seen’ the K2C1 rifle he used during his visit to the Yeonpyeong unit last month, stating, “A political attack based on fabrication rather than factual reporting is not a proper attitude for the media.” (이재명 대통령이 지난달 연평부대 방문 당시 자신이 사용한 소총 K2C1을 현역 군인 대다수는 ‘본 적도 없다’고 지적한 보도에 대해 13일 “사실에 기초한 보도가 아니라 조작에 기초한 정치적 공격은 언론으로서 온당한 태도가 아니다”고 말했다.)

That evening, President Lee cited an article from OhmyNews titled ‘President Lee’s Fired Rifle, Soldiers Have Never Seen? <Chosun>’s Distortion’ on X (formerly Twitter), refuting the report from the Chosun Ilbo. (이 대통령은 이날 저녁 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘이 대통령이 사격한 총, 병사들은 본 적도 없다? <조선>의 왜곡’이라는 제목의 오마이뉴스의 기사를 인용하며 조선일보의 보도를 반박했다.)

On the same day, the Chosun Ilbo reported that President Lee used a K2C1 rifle equipped with an optical sight and target designator during his visit to the Marine Corps Yeonpyeong unit on the 24th of last month, but the majority of active-duty soldiers actually use older K2 rifles that cannot accommodate such accessories. The Chosun Ilbo cited data on ‘K2 Rifle Status of the Army, Navy, and Air Force’ submitted by the Ministry of National Defense to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Yong-won. However, OhmyNews cited explanatory materials from the Ministry of National Defense stating that all infantry combat personnel at the Yeonpyeong unit use K2C1 rifles, contradicting the Chosun Ilbo article. <<> Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Jeong Bit-na also stated on X that day, “The Yeonpyeong unit visited by the President uses K2C1 rifles for all infantry combat personnel.” Jeong added, “Approximately 170,000 K2C1 rifles have been deployed and are in operation at key guard and front-line units, with additional deployment planned according to the mission priorities of the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps,” calling the report “a clear distortion for claiming the President fired a rifle that soldiers had never seen.” <<> Jeong further noted, “For rifles exceeding their service life, we maintain constant operational readiness through inspections of the condition of military supplies, preventive maintenance, and depot-level repairs,” and “To overcome the limitations of the current K2 rifle, we are supplying various types of sights to ensure no disruptions in mission performance before the full deployment of the K2C1 rifle.” <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (이날 조선일보는 이 대통령이 지난달 24일 해병대 연평부대에 방문했을 때 광학조준기와 표적지시기 등이 부착된 K2C1 소총을 사용했지만, 정작 현역 군인 대다수는 부가장비를 달 수 없는 구형 K2 소총을 쓰고 있다고 보도했다. 조선일보는 국방부가 국민의힘 유용원 의원실에 제출한 ‘육·해·공군 K2 총기현황’ 자료를 인용했다. 그러나 오마이뉴스는 연평부대 모든 보병 전투 요원이 K2C1을 사용하고 있다는 국방부 설명 자료를 인용해 해당 조선일보 기사는 사실과 다르다고 했다.)

item.title: Chung Pointsik: “Senior Lawmakers Take Hardline Stance…By May 17 Parliamentary Formation Seems Unlikely” (정점식 “다선 의원들 강경…17일 원 구성 물 건너가”)
item.description:
Chung Pointsik, floor leader of the People Power Party, said in an interview with *The Hankyoreh* at the National Assembly on the 13th: “There is a strong hardline atmosphere among senior lawmakers,” adding, “With the outcome of today’s general meeting of lawmakers, completing the formation of the parliamentary leadership by the 17th seems unlikely. There is no red line in negotiations.” May 17 is the deadline set by National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik for reaching an agreement on the parliamentary formation. Regarding the issue of party leader Jang Dong-hyuk’s position, Chung indicated the possibility of a prolonged situation, saying, “Opinions within the party are not well coordinated,” and “There is consensus within the party that this issue should not amplify conflict.” (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 13일 국회에서 한 한겨레와의 인터뷰에서 “다선 의원들 사이에서 강경 투쟁 기류가 강하다”며 “오늘 의원총회 결과로 17일까지 원 구성을 마무리하는 것은 물 건너갔다. 협상에 마지노선은 없다”고 말했다. 17일은 조정식 국회의장이 제시한 원 구성 협상 기한이다. 정 원내대표는 장동혁 대표의 거취 문제를 두곤 “당내 의견이 잘 모아지지 않는다”며 “이 문제가 갈등을 증폭시켜선 안 된다는 데는 당내 의견이 일치한다”고 장기화 가능성을 내비쳤다.)

―What conclusion did today’s general meeting of lawmakers reach regarding negotiations on parliamentary formation? ( ―오늘 원 구성 협상 관련 의원총회 결론은?)

“The general meeting decided to entrust the floor leader with the negotiations on parliamentary formation. Senior lawmakers with four or five terms whom I met this morning said, ‘We cannot just go along with the Democratic Party’s threats without achieving results like a special counsel law or reallocation of standing committees. It is desirable to wage a strong struggle through whatever means.’ Completing the parliamentary formation by the 17th is off the table.” ( “의총에서는 원 구성 관련 협상을 원내대표에게 위임한다고 했다. 오전에 만난 4·5선 의원들은 ‘특검법이나 상임위 재배분 등 성과 없이 더불어민주당이 협박한다고 들어갈 순 없지 않나. 어떤 방법이든 강한 투쟁을 벌이는 게 바람직하다’고 했다. 17일 원 구성 마무리는 물 건너갔다.”)

―Which standing committees in the National Assembly are essential to secure? ( ―꼭 확보해야 하는 국회 상임위는?)

“If we have to give [the Democratic Party] any standing committee without the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, it looks like a squabble over positions.” ( “지금 법제사법위원회 없이 (민주당에) 어느 상임위를 줘야 한다고 하면 자리다툼으로 비친다.”)

―The Democratic Party is proposing a special counsel investigation into the ballot shortage incident, with recommendations from a third party such as the Korean Bar Association. ( ―더불어민주당은 투표용지 부족 사태 관련 선거관리위원회 특검을 대한변호사협회 등 ‘제3자 추천’을 하자고 하는데.)

“We are giving it much thought. The ruling party has been rejecting the opposition’s recommended special counsel, but there is a strong public demand to uncover the truth of the ballot shortage incident through a special counsel.” ( “여러 고민을 하고 있다. 여당이 야당 추천 특검을 계속 거부하고 있는데, 특검을 통해 투표용지 부족 사태를 규명해야 한다는 국민들의 강한 요구가 있다.”)

―Yoon Sang-hyun, chair of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the June 3 Local Elections Ballot Shortage Scandal, said he would push for a recount of the 2.47 million sealed ballots in Songpa District. ( ―윤상현 국회 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사특위 위원장은 봉쇄된 송파구 투표용지 247만장 재검표를 추진한다고 했는데.)

“That is not the party’s position. Even members of our party on the special committee are divided in opinion. It is a matter to be decided in connection with introducing a special counsel.” ( “당 입장 아니다. 우리 당 국조특위 위원들도 찬반 의견이 갈려 있다. 특검 도입과 연계해 결정할 문제다.”)

―What do you think about leader Jang’s push for an off-the-ballot-by-election? ( ―장 대표의 장외 재선거 촉구 행보를 어떻게 보나?)

“It is a schedule where the party leader joins out of empathy for recognizing the issue of young people’s voting rights. He does not ask lawmakers to necessarily attend, and lawmakers attend by their own free will.” ( “청년들의 참정권 문제 인식에 공감하는 차원에서 당대표가 함께하는 일정이다. 의원들에게 꼭 참석해달라고 하지 않고, 의원들도 자유 의지로 참석한다.”)

―After taking office as floor leader, you said the issue of leader Jang’s position should not be dragged out, but there has been no progress. ( ―원내대표 취임 뒤 장 대표 거취를 오래 끌 일 아니라고 했는데 진전이 아직도 없다.)

“The leader’s position is not an issue that must be decided within a month. Party opinions are not aligning well.” ( “대표 거취가 1개월 이내 결정돼야 하는 사안이 아니다. 당내 의견이 잘 안 모인다.”)

―Regarding leader Jang’s position, is there any behind-the-scenes persuasion for Supreme Council members like Shin Dong-wook and Kim Jae-won to resign? ( ―장 대표 거취와 관련해 신동욱·김재원 등 최고위원 물밑 사퇴 설득이 진행되고 있나?)

“There are many opinions that forcing the party leader to resign by having Supreme Council members step down is not desirable.” ( “최고위원 사퇴로 당대표를 강제로 사퇴시키는 건 바람직하지 않단 의견이 많다.”)

―Doesn’t the concept of a ‘people’s party’ conflict with leader Jang’s ‘member-centered party’? ( ―‘국민 정당’은 장 대표의 ‘당원 중심 정당’과 충돌하는 거 아닌가?)

“There is no conflict. It means we must not become like the Democratic Party, which is controlled by a few hardline supporters who blindly follow what some members argue. If we only focus on party members instead of the people, what expectations can we have for the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election?” ( “충돌 아니다. 일부 당원이 주장하는 대로 무작정 끌려가는 개딸 중심의 민주당처럼 돼선 안 된다는 거다. 국민이 아닌 당원들만 바라보고 갈 때 2028년 총선과 2030년 대선에서 어떤 기대를 할 수 있겠나.”)

―The issue of reinstating lawmaker Han Dong-hoon’s party membership has resurfaced. ( ―한동훈 의원 복당 문제가 재점화됐다.)

“This is not the time to discuss the reinstatement of lawmaker Han.” ( “지금 한 의원 복당 문제를 거론할 시기가 아니다.”)

―How will you overcome the decline in the party’s approval ratings? ( ―당 지지율 하락을 어떻게 극복할 건가?)

“Last week, I had a meal with some lawmakers from the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, and there was even a joke that ‘this is the first time we’ve had a meal or conversation just among ourselves.’ We must first tear down the walls we have built ourselves.” ( “지난주 일부 친한동훈계 의원들과 식사했는데 ‘우리끼리 식사도, 대화도 처음’이라는 농담이 나올 정도였다. 우리 스스로 쌓은 벽부터 허물어야 한다.”)

By Jang Narae and Cho Hee-yeon, staff reporters wing@hani.co.kr ( 장나래 조희연 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party leader 'preferential voting system' to be adopted...'elected youth supreme council member' rejected (민주 당대표 ‘선호투표제’ 도입키로…‘선출직 청년최고위원’은 부결)
item.description:
The supreme council of the Democratic Party of Korea approved a revision to party rules on the 14th, allowing the method of electing the party leader at the August 17 national convention to be a preferential voting system. However, a proposal to separately elect one out of five elected supreme council members as a youth representative was rejected following a vote by the supreme council. (더불어민주당 최고위원회의가 14일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선출 방식을 선호투표제로 할 수 있게 하는 내용의 당규 개정안을 의결했다. 다만 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 1명을 청년으로 분리 선출하는 내용은 최고위원 표결을 거쳐 부결됐다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun of the Democratic Party met with reporters after the closed-door supreme council meeting and stated, “We decided to stipulate in the party rules that both the preferential voting system and the runoff voting system can be used as methods for conducting a runoff election,” adding, “The related party rule revision was approved today.” (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 비공개 최고위 직후 기자들을 만나 “(당규에) 결선투표 실시 방법으로 선호투표제와 결선투표제를 할 수 있음을 명문화하기로 했다”며 “관련 당규 개정의 건을 오늘 의결했다”고 말했다.)

The introduction of an elected youth supreme council member was rejected through a vote by the supreme council. Senior spokesperson Kang further said, “Regarding the method of electing a youth supreme council member, we sought to separate one out of five elected supreme council members to be elected as a youth representative, but the motion was rejected by vote.” (선출직 청년 최고위원 도입은 최고위원 표결을 거쳐 부결됐다. 이어 강 수석대변인은 “청년 최고위원 선출 방법에 대해선 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 1명을 청년 최고위원으로 분리해 선출하고자 했지만 표결에 의해 안건이 부결됐다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Supreme Council Member Lee Sung-yoon resigned from his position on the same day. This is believed to be in protest of the supreme council’s decision, as Lee held the stance that the preferential voting system violates the party constitution and rules. (한편, 이성윤 최고위원은 이날 최고위원직에서 사퇴했다. 이 최고위원은 선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반이라는 입장으로 이날 최고위 결정에 반발하며 사퇴한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Reporters: Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party "Oh Se-hoon also benefited from Myung Tae-kyun...the hammer of justice must fall" (민주 “오세훈도 명태균 수혜자…법의 철퇴 내려져야”)
item.description:
As former President Yoon Suk-yeol was sentenced to two years in prison for receiving free opinion polls from political broker Myung Tae-kyun, the Democratic Party of Korea launched an offensive against Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who is on trial for the "Myung Tae-kyun opinion poll payment scandal," calling him "Seoul's Yoon Suk-yeol" and asserting that "the hammer of justice must fall." (정치 브로커 명태균씨에게 여론조사를 무상으로 받은 혐의로 윤석열 전 대통령이 징역 2년을 선고받은 가운데, 더불어민주당이 ‘명태균 여론조사 대납 혐의’로 재판을 받고 있는 오세훈 서울시장을 향해 “서울의 윤석열”이라며 “법의 철퇴가 내려져야 한다”고 공세에 나섰다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mi said in a briefing at the National Assembly communication center on the 13th, regarding former President Yoon's guilty verdict, that "justice has prevailed, and we welcome this historic ruling that restores national sovereignty." (박경미 민주당 대변인은 13일 국회 소통관에서 한 브리핑에서 윤 전 대통령 유죄 판결을 두고 “사필귀정, 국민 주권을 바로 세운 역사적 판결을 환영한다”고 밝혔다.)

She added, "Today's conviction makes it clear that the beneficiaries of the Myung Tae-kyun-style opinion polls are not only former President Yoon. There is no reason for the strict standards set by this ruling to be dulled in Mayor Oh Se-hoon's trial. We will closely watch for a consistent and stern judgment from the judiciary until the end." (이어 “오늘 유죄가 확인된 명태균표 여론조사의 수혜자는 윤 전 대통령만이 아니”라며 “이번 판결이 세운 엄정한 잣대가 오세훈 시장 재판에서 무뎌질 이유가 없다. 사법부의 일관되고 준엄한 판단을 끝까지 지켜보겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min also posted on Facebook on the 13th, stating, "There is someone who should take today's ruling seriously," referring to Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who is on trial for allegedly receiving ten opinion polls from Myung Tae-kyun's side and having a long-time supporter pay the costs on his behalf. (박주민 민주당 의원도 13일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “오늘 판결을 무겁게 받아들여야 할 사람이 있다”며 “명태균 쪽의 여론조사를 10차례 제공받고, 그 비용을 오랜 후원자가 대신 내게 했다는 혐의로 재판을 받고 있는 오세훈 시장”이라고 오 시장을 거론했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Seo Young-gyo also argued in a Facebook post on the 14th, "Seoul's Yoon Suk-yeol, Oh Se-hoon, must also face the hammer of justice. The court must deliver a stern judgment based solely on the law, evidence, and common sense." (서영교 민주당 의원도 14일 페이스북 글에서 “서울의 윤석열, 오세훈에게도 법의 철퇴가 내려져야 한다”며 “법원은 오직 법과 증거, 그리고 국민 상식에 따른 준엄한 심판을 내려야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Earlier on the 13th, the 33rd Criminal Division of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Lee Jin-gwan) sentenced former President Yoon to two years in prison on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. This conclusion stands in stark contrast to the acquittals of First Lady Kim Keon-hee, who was separately indicted for the same criminal facts and found not guilty in both the first and second trials. Former President Yoon had been on trial for conspiring with First Lady Kim, receiving opinion poll results favorable to him from Mr. Myung between April 2021 and March 2022, and in exchange, assisting with nominations for former People Power Party lawmaker Kim Young-sun and others in the 2022 by-elections. (앞서 13일 서울중앙지법 형사33부(재판장 이진관)는 정치자금법 위반 혐의를 받는 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 2년을 선고했다. 동일한 범죄사실로 별도 기소된 김건희 여사가 1·2심에서 모두 무죄를 선고받은 것과는 정반대의 결론이다. 윤 전 대통령은 김 여사와 공모해 2021년 4월~2022년 3월 명씨로부터 윤 전 대통령에게 유리한 여론조사 결과를 제공받고, 그 대가로 2022년 재보궐선거에서 김영선 전 국민의힘 의원 등 공천을 도와준 혐의로 재판을 받아왔다.)

Mayor Oh was also indicted in December last year on charges related to the "Myung Tae-kyun opinion poll payment scandal," and his first trial verdict is scheduled for the 22nd. Mayor Oh is accused of receiving ten opinion poll results from Mr. Myung ahead of the April 7, 2021, Seoul mayoral by-election and having his close associate, former Seoul Deputy Mayor for Political Affairs Kang Chul-won, arrange for supporter and businessman Kim Han-jung to pay 33 million won in costs (violating the Political Funds Act). The special prosecution team led by Min Joong-ki requested a sentence of one year and six months in prison and an additional fine of 33 million won for Mayor Oh during the closing arguments on the 17th of last month. (오 시장도 지난해 12월 ‘명태균 여론조사 대납 혐의’로 기소돼 오는 22일 1심 선고를 앞두고 있다. 오 시장은 2021년 4·7 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 명씨로부터 10차례 여론조사 결과를 받고 측근인 강철원 전 서울시 정무부시장을 통해 후원자인 사업가 김한정씨에게 비용 3300만원을 대납하게 한 혐의(정치자금법 위반)를 받는다. 민중기 특검팀은 지난달 17일 결심공판에서 오 시장에게 징역 1년6개월과 추징금 3300만원을 구형했다.)

Mayor Oh maintains that he never commissioned the opinion polls, reviewed the results, or arranged for the payment of costs. He describes the indictment as "a forced and unreasonable case without a single piece of proper evidence." If a fine of 1 million won or more is finalized in this case, Mayor Oh would have to step down from his mayoral position. (오 시장은 여론조사를 의뢰하거나 결과를 보고받은 적도, 비용을 대납하게 한 적도 없다는 입장이다. “제대로 된 증거가 단 하나도 없는 무리한 짜맞추기 기소”라는 것이다. 이 사건으로 100만원 이상 벌금형이 확정되면 오 시장은 시장직에서 물러나야 한다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun, reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Mobilize All Efforts for Price and Real Estate Stability… Must Raise Potential Growth Rate to 3%" (이 대통령 “물가·부동산 안정 총력…잠재성장률 3%까지 높여야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th, "We must focus all our efforts on stabilizing prices and real estate, which are directly tied to the people's livelihoods, and gradually raise the potential growth rate to 3% by fostering growth engines with super-gap and super-innovation." (이재명 대통령이 14일 “국민 삶에 직결된 물가와 부동산 안정에 총력을 기울이고, 초격차, 초혁신 성장동력 육성으로 잠재 성장률을 3%까지 단계적으로 높여 나가야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office, Cheong Wa Dae, saying, "In the first half of this year, exports have shown explosive growth, approaching $500 billion." He added, "While semiconductors are leading the growth, this is also the result of a 16% increase in the export of other items compared to last year," and noted, "Amid these remarkable export performances and increases in facility investment, there are growing forecasts that the real growth rate could reach 3% this year." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “올해 상반기 수출이 5천억불에 육박하는 폭발적인 증가세를 보이고 있다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “반도체가 성장을 주도하는 가운데, 다른 품목들 수출들도 전년보다 16% 늘어난 결과”라며 “이러한 눈부신 수출 실적과 설비투자 증가를 바탕으로 올해 실질성장률이 3%에 이를 것이란 전망도 잇따르고 있다”고 했다.)

He particularly emphasized a swift push for the "three major mega-projects." President Lee said, "For the early realization of the three major mega-projects, the central government, local governments, and businesses must work together as one. I hope all procedures are carried out as quickly as possible, with the mindset that shortening one day could save ten or even a hundred days later." (특히 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’의 속도전을 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “3대 메가프로젝트 조기 현실화를 위해 중앙정부, 지방정부, 기업이 한몸처럼 열심히 뛰어야겠다. 하루를 단축하면 나중에 열흘, 100일을 벌 수 있다는 자세로 모든 절차를 최대한 빠르게 진행해주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "We must also focus on resolving social structural issues," and added, "We need to provide the youth, who are the future of our community, with multi-layered growth ladders in areas such as jobs, housing, assets, and capacity development. At the same time, we must accelerate innovation in reducing labor market disparities, as well as in public sector finances and regulatory areas." (이 대통령은 이어 “사회 구조적 문제를 해소하는 데도 힘을 쏟아야 한다”며 “우리 공동체 미래인 청년들에게 일자리, 주거, 자산 그리고 역량 개발 등에 있어서 다층적인 성장 사다리를 제공하고, 노동시장 격차 완화와 함께 공공기관 재정, 규제 영역에서 혁신도 속도를 내야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee stated, "The next 30 years of South Korea's future will be determined by the achievements we make in the second half," and urged, "Let us join forces so that this year can be remembered as the starting point for leaping into an irreplaceable South Korea with a potential growth rate of 3%, a position among the world's top four trading nations, and a national income of $50,000." (이 대통령은 “하반기에 우리가 어떤 성과를 만드느냐에 따라 대한민국 미래 30년이 좌우될 것”이라며 “올해가 잠재성장률 3%, 세계 무역 4강, 국민소득 5만불이라는 대체불가 대한민국으로 도약하는 원년으로 기억될 수 있도록 힘을 모아달라”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Jung Cheong-rae Suddenly Brings Up Presidential Election When Administration Has 4 Years Left... Everything Is 'Jung First, Party Later'" (송영길 “정청래, 4년 남은 정권에서 뜬금없이 대선 얘기…모든 게 ‘선청후당’”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker running in the Democratic Party of Korea's party leadership primary, took direct aim at his competitor, former lawmaker Jung Cheong-rae, on the 14th, stating, "Everything so far has been 'Jung first, party later.'" <<> Appearing on CBS Radio that day, Song said, "During the last presidential election, he thoroughly used it as a pretext for early campaigning for his own party leadership race," and asked rhetorically, "While local elections and by-elections may have had some elements aimed at the party's victory, most of the time they were preparations for his own re-election—didn't he appoint 800 of his close associates as special advisors and run them as candidates for local governments?" He added, "(Former lawmaker Jung) prioritized his own political objectives," and noted, "I believe the party members are assessing it that way." <<> Regarding Jung's declaration the previous day at his campaign press conference that "I will not use the party chairmanship to run for president," Song remarked, "It's already out of place to talk about a presidential election when the current administration still has four years left in its term, and claiming you won't use party power to run for president is a strange and sudden statement." He added, "Who asked you to run?" <<> Song said, "It is unprecedented in constitutional history for the media's main focus to be on a 'power struggle between the president and the party leader' during the first year of the president's term." He then added, "We need a ruling party leader who can join forces with the president to upgrade the nation and create an 'irreplaceable Republic of Korea,'" asserting that he is the right person for the job. <<> Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 당 대표 경선에 출마한 송영길 의원이 14일 경쟁자인 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥해 “그동안 모든 게 선청후당(정청래가 먼저, 당이 나중)이었다”고 직격했다.)

item.title: In a Cabinet Meeting, a Surprise Vote on 'Ultra-High-Priced Single Home'... President Lee Says "Unexpected" as Public Opinion Favors 'Over 3 Billion Won' (국무회의서 ‘초고가 1주택' 깜짝 투표…‘30억 이상’ 여론에 이 대통령 “의외네”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung conducted an impromptu vote via comments during a live-streamed Cabinet meeting on the 14th, asking whether a burden should be imposed on the ownership tax for ultra-high-priced single homes. (이재명 대통령이 14일 생중계 국무회의에서 초고가 1주택 보유세 부담 여부를 댓글로 묻는 즉석 투표를 진행했다.)

At the Cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee made an on-the-spot suggestion: "For a single home that is actually lived in, but if it's an ultra-high-priced property, please write 1 in the comments if you agree with imposing an additional ownership burden beyond the usual protection, or 2 if not." He then observed the comments appearing on the live broadcast of the Cabinet meeting for one minute. Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, reported, "About 90% of the opinions were in favor of the additional burden, and about 10% were against." President Lee said, "We will proceed like this at the (real estate grand debate) as well," adding, "As for how much the threshold should be for imposing the additional burden—20, 30, or 40 million won—I wonder if you could press the first digit." When Director Im noted, "Public opinion most favors 30 million won," President Lee replied, "Unexpected. I thought it would be 50 million won." <<> When Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom said, "20 million won also has quite a bit of support," President Lee commented, "If we go with that, we might be in big trouble." Prime Minister Han Seong-sook responded with a smile, "I have nothing to say," to which President Lee asked, "Is it over 20 million won? You don't own a house, do you? Not anymore." Prime Minister Han said, "I do have one house. But it's worth over 20 million won." <<> From this day until the 16th, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Economy and Finance will each hold public forums on the topics of supply, finance, and taxation, respectively, to hear opinions from experts and the public. Afterwards, a grand debate attended by President Lee will be held on the 23rd. <<> Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who was elected in the June 3 local elections, attended his first Cabinet meeting this day and requested to speak. When Mayor Oh asked, "Prime Minister, may I say a word?" Prime Minister Han replied, "Since there is a public grand debate, it would be better to defer. Please submit what you have in writing." <<> Mayor Oh stated, "I have delivered the report prepared by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to the Policy Chief, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy," and added, "Since I won't be given an opportunity to speak, I will substitute it with the contents of the report." President Lee then remarked, "Please also report on how the reconstruction and redevelopment in Seoul is progressing and why there are assessments that the supply volume is insufficient." <<> On this day, the relevant real estate ministries summarized the issues to be covered in the real estate grand debate. Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol said at the Cabinet meeting, "We will operate the real estate tax system not to stabilize housing prices but to improve distortions and irrationalities in the real estate market." The issues identified by the Ministry of Economy and Finance include 11 items: △Differentiation of real estate tax burdens by region △Phased implementation of real estate tax reform △Appropriate level of property tax and comprehensive real estate holding tax △Reform of the comprehensive real estate tax system △Use of comprehensive real estate tax revenue △Reform of the special deduction for long-term holding △Necessity of maintaining the heavy taxation system for multi-homeowners △Need for tax special provisions for the elderly, long-term residents, and relocation to provinces △Necessity of reducing capital gains tax in line with property tax increases △Whether to lower acquisition taxes for ordinary and middle-class households and the need to overhaul the heavy taxation system for multi-homeowners. <<> The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport reported seven issues related to housing supply: △Deregulation to revitalize private redevelopment and reconstruction △Utilization of idle sites in urban centers such as the Yongsan International Business District △Easing financial and tax regulations for multi-homeowners to supply new non-apartment housing △Flexibilization of urban and building regulations △Private rental housing suppliers (to supply rental housing jointly with the public sector) △The proportion of public rental and public sale housing supply. <<> The Financial Services Commission identified three issues: △Need to adjust loan regulations and expand policy loans to support genuine demanders such as youth △Direction of regulatory policy on jeonse (lump-sum deposit) loans △Regulations on relocation loans. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji: yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “실거주 1주택인데, 초고가 주택에 대해선 통상적인 보호보다는 추가 보유 부담을 하는 데 동의하면 1번, 아니면 2번을 (댓글로) 써달라”고 즉석 제안했고, 1분간 국무회의 생중계에 달리는 댓글을 살폈다. 임기근 국무조정실장은 “추가 부담에 찬성하는 의견이 약 90%, 반대가 약 10%였다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “(부동산 대토론회에서도) 이렇게 진행할 것”이라며 “얼마 이상부터 추가 부담을 부과할지 20억, 30억, 40억을 얼마로 할지는 앞글자 눌러보시면 어떻겠나 싶다”고 말했다. 임 실장이 “국민 의견이 30억이 (제일 많다)”고 하자 이 대통령은 “의외네, 50억은 할 줄 알았는데”라고 답했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Lowering the age of juvenile offenders by one year is insufficient... I will not make a final decision today." (이 대통령 “촉법소년 1살 낮추는 건 미약…오늘 최종 결정 안 하겠다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th regarding ongoing discussions about lowering the age of criminal minors (juvenile offenders) from under 14 to under 13 years old, specifically for violent, serious, and repeat offenses, "It seems we do need to lower it," and "I hear it's about lowering it by one year for certain crimes, but I think that might be too insufficient." (이재명 대통령이 14일 형사미성년자(촉법소년) 연령 기준을 강력·중대·반복 범죄에 한해 만 14살 미만에서 13살 미만으로 하향하자는 논의가 이뤄지고 있는 것과 관련 “낮추긴 낮춰야 할 것 같다”, “특정범죄에 대해선 1살 낮추자는 거 같은데 그건 너무 미약하지 않냐는 생각이 든다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a cabinet meeting held at the Blue House, after receiving a report from the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family on public discussions about the age criteria for criminal minors. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 성평등가족부의 형사미성년자 연령 기준 공론화와 관련한 보고를 들은 뒤 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee added, "I've seen scenes where (offenders) commit crimes while saying, 'I won't be punished.'" He continued, "Looking at that, isn't one year too short? For example, a 12-year-old could commit murder or a serious crime." He further noted, "Globally, there are quite a few cases where the age (of juvenile offenders) is set at 12, aren't there?" (이 대통령은 “‘나 처벌 안 받아’라고 하면서 (범죄를) 저지르는 장면도 있더라”며 “그런 걸 보면, 1살만으로 부족하지 않냐. 예를 들어 12살인데 살해나 중범죄를 저지를 수도 있지 않느냐”라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “전 세계적으로 (촉법소년 연령을) 12살로 하는 경우도 꽤 많지 않냐”고 덧붙였다.)

When President Lee asked, "I heard many experts were opposed to lowering the age of juvenile offenders at all, preferring to maintain the status quo," Minister Won Min-kyung of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family responded, "It seems the public often misunderstands 'juvenile offenders' as not being punished, but in reality, long-term detention for up to two years at a juvenile detention center is possible, and serious measures follow. People just weren't aware." (이 대통령이 이어 “전문가들은 촉법소년 연령을 아예 안 낮추고, 현상 유지하는 의견이 많았다고 하던데”라고 묻자 원민경 성평등가족부 장관은 “국민들은 촉법소년이라고 하면, 처벌을 안 받는 것으로 많이 오해하는 거 같은데 사실상 소년원 2년간 장기 송치 처분이 가능하고 중대한 처분이 뒤따른다는 걸 잘 몰랐던 거 같다”고 답했다.)

However, Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho pointed out, "For juvenile offenders, no criminal record remains, so it doesn't pose any obstacle when entering public office." At this, President Lee made a pointed joke, saying, "So that's why the story about Lee Jae-myung's juvenile detention center comes up." During the presidential election, false news had circulated that President Lee had been in a juvenile detention center. (다만 정성호 법무부 장관은 “소년범의 경우 전과가 남지 않아 공직에 갈 때 아무런 장애가 되지 않는다”고 말했다. 그러자 이 대통령은 “그래서 이재명 소년원 얘기가 나오는구나”라고 뼈 있는 농담을 하기도 했다. 대선 당시 이 대통령이 소년원 출신이라는 가짜뉴스가 돌기도 했다.)

President Lee stated, "This is a difficult topic. Let's not make a final decision today, but gather more opinions from our citizens." He added, "The question remains whether we'll lower it by one year or two years. It does seem we need to lower it. Let's discuss whether to lower it partially or fully, and whether to apply it to all crimes. In the meantime, let's collect public opinions." (이 대통령은 “어려운 주제인데, 오늘 최종결정을 하지 말고, 우리 국민들 의견을 더 수렴해보자”며 “한 살 또는 두 살을 낮출 거냐 이게 남는 건데, 낮추긴 낮춰야 할 것 같다. 부분적으로 낮출 건지, 전면적으로 낮출 건지, 모든 범죄에 낮출 건지 이 범위 내에서 토론을 한 번 해보고 그 사이에 국민 의견을 수렴해보자”고 말했다.)

item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon attended a State Council meeting presided over by President Lee Jae-myung at the presidential office Yongsan on the 14th. It was his first attendance at a State Council meeting in 11 months since August of last year, and his first after being elected to a fifth term as Seoul Mayor in the June 3 local elections. (오세훈 서울시장이 14일 청와대에서 열린 이재명 대통령 주재 국무회의에 참석했다. 오 시장의 국무회의 참석은 지난해 8월 이후 11개월 만이며 6·3 지방선거에서 5선 서울시장으로 당선된 뒤 처음이다.)

On this day, after the Ministry of Economy and Finance, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and Financial Services Commission reported on the "Plan for Gathering Public Opinions on Real Estate Policies," Mayor Oh requested to speak. However, Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, who was moderating the discussion, mentioned the schedule for the National Grand Debate and said, "Since there is a grand debate on this matter, it would be better to defer the discussion to that forum. Please submit your input in writing instead of an oral statement. We will accept this item as originally proposed." (이날 오 시장은 ‘부동산 정책 관련 국민 의견 수렴 계획’에 대한 재정경제부와 국토교통부·금융위원회의 보고가 끝나자, 발언을 신청했지만 토론 진행을 맡은 한성숙 국무총리는 국민 대토론회 일정을 언급하며 “이 건은 대토론회가 있으니 그쪽으로 넘겨 논의하는 것이 좋겠다”며 “시장님이 주실 것은 구두 발언 대신 서류로 받도록 하겠다. 이 부분은 원안대로 접수하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: President Lee: “If reforms are loud, they may look cool but lead to stronger resistance…Hard to achieve results” (이 대통령 “개혁, 요란하면 멋있어도 저항 강해져…성과내기 어렵다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 14th regarding reforms, “If you shout a lot and make a big commotion, it might look cool, but doing so increases the intensity of resistance and makes it hard to achieve results.” (이재명 대통령이 14일 개혁과 관련해 “소리를 많이 지르고, 요란하게 하면 멋있을지는 몰라도 그렇게 하면 저항 강도가 세지고 성과를 내기가 어렵다”고 말했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting held at the Presidential Office that day, President Lee stated, “Recently, regarding reforms, there seems to be talk that the Lee Jae-myung administration only talks about growth and the economy. Some wonder if we are neglecting reforms or turning our backs on welfare,” adding the above remarks. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “최근 개혁과 관련해 이재명 정부가 너무 성장과 경제 얘기만 한다. 개혁을 소홀히 하는 거 아니냐. 복지를 외면하는 거 아니냐는 얘기를 하는 거 같다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee further said, “That is an area of government determination. Welfare policies are being expanded as much as needed. If necessary, welfare-related departments should just steadily move forward as originally planned. The intensity of resistance is high, and the amount of cheers generated by the results of reforms is inevitably small. That’s why social reform is difficult.” (이어 이 대통령은 “그건 정부의 결단의 영역”이라며 “복지 정책은 필요한 만큼 계속 확장해가고 있다. 필요하면 복지 관련 부서들은 우리가 원래 계획대로 뚜벅뚜벅 가면 된다. 저항의 강도는 크고, 개혁의 성과에 따라서는 생기는 환호의 양은 적고 그럴 수밖에 없다. 그래서 사회개혁은 어렵다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee also commented on specific methods of reform. He said, “Does shouting loudly, speaking harshly, and making aggressive gestures lead to success? It might feel good, but the results are unlikely to be good. That’s why reform is more difficult than revolution.” (이 대통령은 개혁의 구체적 방법에 대해서도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “목소리 크고, 세게 얘기하고 삿대질을 하면 잘 되냐. 뭐 기분은 좋을지 몰라도 결과는 좋기 어렵다”며 “그래서 혁명보다 개혁이 더 어렵다”고 말했다.)

President Lee’s remarks draw attention as they come amid disagreements within the Democratic Party of Korea over issues such as the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority related to prosecution reform. President Lee stated, “We need to persuade, gain broad public consensus on the legitimacy, and proceed step by step and effectively, so that ‘someday it has changed.’ The process of building consensus is difficult and can take time. There are cases where people think of pragmatism as the opposite of reform, but that’s not the case.” (이 대통령의 발언은 더불어민주당 내 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부 등 검찰개혁을 둘러싼 이견이 제기된 가운데 나와 주목된다. 이 대통령은 “설득하고, 정당성에 대해 많은 사람들의 공감을 얻고 순차적으로 실효적으로 해서 ‘어느 순간 바뀌었네’ 이렇게 해야 한다”며 “공감하는 과정이 어렵고, 시간이 걸리기도 한다. 우리가 실용이 마치 개혁의 반대말처럼 생각하는 경우들이 있는데 그런 게 아니다”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Tells Mayor Oh Se-hoon, “Report Why Reconstruction and Redevelopment Are Delayed” (이 대통령, 오세훈 시장에 “재건축·재개발 지연 이유 보고해달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung told Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who attended the Cabinet meeting on the 14th, “Congratulations on your election,” and added, “Please report why reconstruction and redevelopment are being delayed, along with the reasons and countermeasures.” (이재명 대통령이 14일 국무회의에 참석한 오세훈 서울시장에게 “당선 축하한다”며 “재건축·재개발이 왜 지연되는지, 그 이유와 대책을 보고해달라”고 말했다.)

President Lee gave Mayor Oh a chance to speak at the end of the Cabinet meeting he chaired at the presidential office that day. Mayor Oh began, “I will do my utmost to improve the quality of life for Seoul citizens. What’s a bit disappointing is that although several meetings on real estate measures have been prepared, aside from that, here at the Cabinet meeting with fellow ministers, regarding Seoul’s housing administration…” At that point, President Lee interrupted him, saying, “Let’s talk about that later.” Mayor Oh then said, “The report I prepared contains some uncomfortable points. Since it’s been drafted as discussion material, I hope you will read it and ensure various opinions are adopted in a balanced way. Thank you very much for giving me this opportunity to speak.” <<> Earlier, during the early part of the Cabinet meeting, while there was a briefing and discussion on the topic of “Plan for Collecting Public Opinions on Real Estate Policy,” Mayor Oh requested to speak, asking, “Prime Minister, may I say something?” But Prime Minister Han Seong-sook replied, “A public debate is scheduled on this matter. I will receive your opinions in written form,” denying him the opportunity to speak. <<> In response, Mayor Oh said, “I have already forwarded the report prepared by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to the Policy Office Director, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport, and the Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy. Since it seems I won’t be given a chance to speak, I will substitute with the contents of the report.” Then President Lee said, “Please also report on how Seoul’s reconstruction and redevelopment are progressing and why there are assessments that the supply volume is insufficient.” <<> By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 막바지에 오 시장에게 발언 기회를 줬다. 오 시장은 “서울시민의 삶의 질 향상을 위해 최선의 노력을 다하겠다. 조금 아쉬운 것은 부동산 관련 대책 회의가 여러 차례 준비돼 있지만, 그것과 무관하게 국무회의에서 여러 국무위원 모시고 서울시의 주택 행정 관련…”이라고 발언하는 과정에서 이 대통령이 말을 끊었다. 이 대통령은 “그 얘기는 나중에 하시죠”라고 말했다. 그러자 오 시장은 “준비한 보고서에 불편한 내용도 있다”며 “토론자료로 작성된 것인 만큼 일독하셔서 다양한 의견이 균형 있게 채택되면 좋겠다. 말씀드릴 기회를 주셔서 정말 감사드린다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Leaving Abortion Pill Unregulated is Irresponsible... Could Also Leave It to Doctors' Discretion" (이 대통령 “임신중단약 도입 방치 무책임…의사에 맡기는 방법도”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th regarding the issue of introducing the abortion pill (Mifepristone) domestically that "it is irresponsible for the government to continue neglecting this matter" and instructed relevant ministries to come up with practical solutions. (이재명 대통령이 14일 임신중단약(미프진) 국내 도입 문제와 관련해 “정부가 지금처럼 방치하는 것은 무책임하다”며 관련 부처에 실용적인 해결 방안을 마련하라고 지시했다.)

During a Cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee said, "It seems that since it is not permitted here, women are buying it through overseas direct purchases, but because women who actually need it are purchasing and taking it directly from abroad, accidents are occurring," adding, "Even if there are difficulties for the government, shouldn't we enable them to take it properly?" (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 “우리는 허용이 안 돼 여성들이 해외 직구를 통해 복용하는 것 같은데, 현실적으로 필요한 여성들이 해외에서 직접 구매해 복용하다 보니 사고도 난다”며 “정부에 어려움이 있더라도 적정하게 투약할 수 있게 해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 말했다.)

Pointing out that the issue of allowing the abortion pill is tied up with legislative discussions on the scope of abortion permissions, President Lee said, "If we try to resolve all the fundamental issues at once, we won't be able to do anything. If we keep debating this, we might not reach a conclusion until the end of my term." He added, "In principle, it is right to set a period for allowing abortion and have doctors prescribe within that period," but stressed, "In reality, women who need it are buying and taking the drug from abroad without any oversight, and this leaves the government shirking responsibility while only the people are placed in danger, abandoned outside the law." <<> President Lee also indicated that utilizing doctors' discretion could be considered. He said, "Even before alternative legislation is prepared, there might be a way to let doctors decide whether to prescribe at their own discretion." He added, "Even if it's imperfect, wouldn't it be better than leaving things unattended?" <<> President Lee ordered Prime Minister Han Sung-sook to coordinate with relevant ministries, saying, "I hope we can come up with a solution through a compromise approach. This doesn't seem like something we can just let slide." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 임신중단약 허용이 낙태 허용 범위와 관련한 입법 논의에 묶여 있는 상황을 지적하며 “원론적인 문제까지 다 해결하려고 하다 보면 아무것도 못 한다”며 “이 문제를 논의하다가는 임기 끝날 때까지 결론을 못 낼 수도 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “원칙적으로는 낙태 허용 기간을 정하고 그 기간 안에서 의사가 처방하도록 하는 것이 맞다”면서도 “현실적으로 필요한 여성들은 아무런 관리 없이 해외에서 약을 구입해 복용하는 상황인데, 법 밖에 방치된 채 정부는 책임을 피하고 국민만 위험에 빠지는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Following North Korea’s Premier’s Visit to China, Wang Huning, China’s Fourth-Highest Ranking Official, to Visit North Korea from 15th to 17th (북 총리 방중 이어 ‘중국 서열 4위’ 왕후닝 15∼17일 방북)
item.description:
Shortly after North Korean Premier Pak Thae-song’s visit to China, a Chinese Party and government delegation led by Wang Huning, Chairman of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) and the fourth-ranking figure in China’s political hierarchy, will visit North Korea from the 15th to the 17th. This follows Chinese President Xi Jinping’s first visit to North Korea in seven years last month, continuing the trend of close engagement between the two countries. <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 14th that “at the invitation of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, a delegation of the Chinese Communist Party and government, headed by Comrade Wang Huning, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference, will pay an official goodwill visit to our country from the 15th to the 17th.” <<> Chairman Wang’s visit to North Korea follows immediately after Premier Pak Thae-song’s official visit to China from the 10th to the 12th to mark the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty). The North Korean Party and government delegation led by Premier Pak visited China for three days and two nights starting on the 10th to attend events commemorating the treaty’s 65th anniversary. Premier Pak met with top Chinese officials, including President Xi Jinping, Premier Li Qiang of the State Council, Chairman Zhao Leji of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress, and Cai Qi, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party, who rank from first to third and fifth in China’s hierarchy, and received VIP-level treatment. <<> With President Xi Jinping’s visit to North Korea last month—the first in seven years since 2019—North Korea and China reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening strategic communication and expanding cooperation through summit talks and a joint statement. Subsequently, to mark the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Friendship Treaty, Chairman Xi and Chairman Kim Jong Un exchanged congratulatory messages and dispatched high-level delegations to each other, showcasing their close relationship as “strategic partners.” <<> Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박태성 북한 내각총리가 방중한 직후 중국 권력 서열 4위인 왕후닝 전국인민정치협상회의(정협) 주석이 이끄는 중국 당정 대표단이 15∼17일 북한을 방문한다. 지난달 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 7년만의 방북에 이어 양국의 밀착 행보가 계속되고 있다.)

item.title: Election Commission Doles Out 17.5 Billion Won in Contracts to Former Officials and Family Companies... Also Supplies Semi-Transparent Advance Voting Boxes (선관위, 전관·가족회사에 175억 일감 몰아줘…반투명 사전투표함도 납품)
item.description:
Companies whose representatives or executives include former high-ranking officials of the National Election Commission (NEC) and their family members have been found to have signed contracts with the commission totaling over 17.5 billion won. (선거관리위원회 전직 간부와 그 가족이 대표를 맡거나 임원으로 참여한 업체들이 선관위와 체결한 계약 규모가 175억원을 넘는 것으로 나타났다.)

According to data submitted by the NEC and others on the 14th to Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly’s Special Committee for the Parliamentary Investigation into the Shortage of Ballot Papers for the June 3 Local Elections (the special investigation committee), three companies linked to a former senior official of the National Election Commission, referred to as Mr. A, and his family signed a total of 103 contracts with the NEC, amounting to 17.55323 billion won. Of these, 90 contracts were awarded through private negotiation. (국회 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위) 소속 주진우 국민의힘 의원이 14일 선관위 등으로부터 제출받은 자료를 보면, 중앙선관위 출신의 ㄱ씨와 그 가족이 관련된 3개 업체가 선관위와 체결한 계약은 총 103건으로 175억5323만원 규모에 달하는 것으로 나타났다. 이 가운데 90건이 수의계약이었다.)

Specifically, Company B, of which Mr. A serves as CEO, has just three employees and signed a total of 66 contracts (worth 2.9752 billion won) with the NEC, with 64 of them being private contracts. This company also supplied the semi-transparent in-district advance voting boxes that sparked controversy during the recent June 3 local elections. (구체적으로는 ㄱ씨가 대표이사로 있는 ㄴ업체가 직원 3명을 두고 선관위와 총 66건(29억 7520만원 규모)의 계약을 체결했고 이 가운데 64건이 수의계약이었다. 이 업체는 이번 6·3 지방선거에서 논란이 된 반투명 관내 사전투표함을 납품하기도 했다.)

Company C, represented by Mr. A’s spouse, signed a total of nine contracts with the NEC worth 490.45 million won, eight of which were private contracts. Companies B and C were located on the same floor of the same building, and Mr. A was once registered as an auditor for Company C. (ㄱ씨의 배우자가 대표인 ㄷ업체는 선관위와 총 9건, 4억945만원의 계약을 체결했다. 이 가운데 8건이 수의계약이었다. ㄴ업체와 ㄷ업체는 같은 건물·같은 층에 있었고, ㄱ씨는 이 회사의 감사로 등기된 이력이 있다.)

Company D, where Mr. A served as an internal director, also signed a total of 28 contracts with the NEC worth 14.16858 billion won. Among these, 18 contracts (valued at 4.34808 billion won) were awarded through private negotiation. (ㄱ씨가 사내이사로 참여했던 ㄹ업체도 선관위와 총 28건, 141억6858만원의 계약을 체결했다. 이 중 18건(43억4808만원 규모)은 수의계약이다.)

At the hearing of the special investigation committee on the same day, Rep. Joo Jin-woo stated, “The NEC is not even a family-owned company, yet this is how the NEC cartel operates, making a special counsel investigation inevitable.” Acting NEC Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan responded, “We will thoroughly reform and correct this,” adding, “We will mobilize all means to ensure that former public officials are not involved in any form of contract arrangements.” (주진우 의원은 이날 국조특위 청문회에서 “선관위가 가족회사도 아니고 이런 식으로 선관위 카르텔이 작동하니까 특검이 불가피하다”고 말했다. 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행은 “철저하게 개혁해서 시정하겠다”며 “전직 공무원들은 어떤 형식이든지 계약에 관여하지 않도록 모든 방법을 동원하겠다”고 답했다.)

item.title: Hong Joon-pyo: "Oh Se-hoon Will Find It Hard to Escape the Myung Tae-kyun Case... Judge Lee Jin-gwan Was Accurate" (홍준표 “오세훈, 명태균 사건 빠져나가기 어려워…이진관 판사 정확”)
item.description:
After former President Yoon Suk-yeol received a prison sentence in the first trial for receiving free polling results from political broker Myung Tae-kyun, former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo stated, "Judge Lee Jin-gwan was accurate in his judgment," and added, "Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon will likely find it hard to escape." (윤석열 전 대통령이 정치브로커 명태균씨로부터 무상 여론조사 결과를 받은 혐의로 1심에서 실형을 선고받자 홍준표 전 대구시장이 “이진관 판사는 정확히 (판결)했다”며 “오세훈 서울시장이 빠져나가기 어렵지 않을까”라고 말했다.)

In an interview with CBS Radio's "Park Jae-hong's One-Round Match" on the 13th, former Mayor Hong said regarding the sentencing of former President Yoon to two years in prison and the court detention of Mr. Myung that day, "I think it was an accurate judgment." He also commented on the earlier acquittal of First Lady Kim Keon-hee in the first and second trials for the same criminal charges, calling it "nonsense." (홍 전 시장은 13일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’와의 인터뷰에서 이날 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 2년이 선고되고 명씨가 법정구속된 데 대해 “정확한 판단이라고 본다”고 말했다. 또 앞서 김건희 여사가 같은 범죄 사실로 기소돼 1·2심에서 무죄를 선고받은 데 대해선 “그게 엉터리였다”고 말했다.)

On that day, Criminal Division 33 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Lee Jin-gwan) sentenced former President Yoon to two years in prison and a fine of approximately 13.96 million won, and Mr. Myung to one year and six months in prison on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. Mr. Myung was detained in court due to concerns over evidence tampering. (이날 서울중앙지법 형사33부(재판장 이진관)는 정치자금법 위반 혐의로 기소된 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 2년에 추징금 약 1396만원을, 명씨에게 징역 1년6개월을 선고했다. 명씨는 ‘증거인멸 우려’로 이날 법정에서 구속됐다.)

In response to the host's remark that "some say that, in light of today's ruling, the chances of Mayor Oh's case resulting in a conviction seem higher," former Mayor Hong said, "Mayor Oh will find it hard to escape the Myung Tae-kyun case." He added, "I know the background of how Oh Se-hoon and Myung Tae-kyun came to meet when that case broke out," and "I heard a lot about Mr. Myung being a poll manipulation fraud from the time I was governor of South Gyeongsang Province." (홍 전 시장은 “오늘 판결을 보면서 오 시장 사건도 유죄가 될 확률이 높아 보인다는 분도 있다”는 진행자의 말에 “명태균 사건에 오 시장이 빠져나가기가 어렵지 않을까”라고 말했다. 홍 전 시장은 “그 사건 터졌을 때부터 오세훈, 명태균이 만나게 된 계기를 내가 안다”며 “(명씨가) 여론 조작 사기꾼이라는 거를 경남지사 할 때부터 이야기를 많이 들었다”고도 했다.)

Earlier, the special investigation team led by Min Joong-ki indicted Mayor Oh in December last year on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. This stemmed from allegations that, ahead of the April 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election, Mayor Oh received polling results from Mr. Myung on ten occasions and arranged for his aide, former Seoul Deputy Mayor for Political Affairs Kang Chul-won, to have businessman and supporter Kim Han-jung pay 33 million won in costs. The special team requested on the 17th of last month that the court sentence Mayor Oh to one year and six months in prison and a 33 million won fine. The first trial verdict is scheduled for the 22nd. <<> Regarding First Lady Kim, who was acquitted in the first and second trials, the Supreme Court is expected to deliver its ruling on the 16th. <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (앞서 민중기 특검팀은 2021년 4월 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 명씨로부터 10차례 여론조사 결과를 받고 측근인 강철원 전 서울시 정무부시장을 통해 후원자인 사업가 김한정씨에게 비용 3300만원을 대납하게 한 혐의(정치자금법 위반)로 지난해 12월 오 시장을 기소했다. 특검팀은 오 시장에게 징역 1년6개월과 추징금 3300만원을 선고해달라고 지난달 17일 재판부에 요청한 상태다. 1심 선고는 오는 22일 열린다.)
